name: Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink
sku: Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink applications and Studio notebooks.

transform.stream-processing.note: Runs Apache Flink applications to process and analyse streaming data, for time-series analytics and real-time dashboards, using the Flink SQL, Table, DataStream and Process Function APIs.

transform.code-transform.note: Applications are written in Java, Scala or Python with embedded SQL, in the developer's own IDE. Its use is streaming; batch transformation is not the point.

bands.note: Provisions compute, fails over across availability zones, scales automatically and backs applications up as checkpoints and snapshots.
Studio notebooks let users query data streams interactively in SQL, Python and Scala, and promote a notebook to a long-running application.

presentation.tagline: Managed Apache Flink for stream processing in Java, Python or SQL.
